title: spiraea crenata subsp. parvifolia
intro: Spiraea crenata subsp. parvifolia, commonly known as Dwarf Spirea, is a flowering plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is a perennial shrub that has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf Spirea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
